verdict.rationale: CRA's own EFILE channel lets enrolled electronic filers transmit many clients' returns system-to-system from certified software and review transmission history, which is the closest documented support for operating across many items. The single-form registration of a BN plus several program accounts is one bundled transaction rather than true bulk processing. Nothing documents batch submission or bulk actions as such. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk submission documentation, bulk operations outside tax-return transmission (e.g., payments, account changes), any programmatic bulk API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
